def solve_gf2(A,b,n):
 M=[list(row)+[rhs] for row,rhs in zip(A,b)]; piv=[];r=0
 for c in range(n):
  p=next((k for k in range(r,len(M)) if M[k][c]),None)
  if p is None:continue
  M[r],M[p]=M[p],M[r]
  for k in range(len(M)):
   if k!=r and M[k][c]: M[k]=[u^v for u,v in zip(M[k],M[r])]
  piv.append(c);r+=1
 if any(not any(row[:n]) and row[n] for row in M):return None
 sol=[0]*n
 for k,c in enumerate(piv):sol[c]=M[k][n]
 return sol
